text: ok now for the gui where this can all be seen and edited in app, i would still treat it like any type of a wiki, since there is no necessary need to introduce a bunch of complexity yet, from here this will let us after having an entity established, be able to decide how any ingame platform for it needs to be made accordingly
resolution: Simplified the durable World Bible plan into a conventional wiki-first GUI in cart/editor: index and search, readable pages, one editing view, simple facts/assets/relations, stable links and backlinks, plus the existing explicit draft-to-disk workflow. Removed specialized inspectors, graph canvases, schedule dashboards, site previews, feed composers, and gig wizards from the first slice. Established the entity-first rule so websites, accounts, listings, documents, missions, and their purpose-specific editors are added later as linked projections only when gameplay proves the need.
